lock: R5 — edit-prompt intent is the user's call
surrounding_logic: The onEdit prop is wired into the <Message> component via the rendering loop (Chat.jsx:1399-1419) and surfaces as a 'Claude-style bubble action' on user-role bubbles (Chat.jsx:1885-1898 in <MessageActions>). The handler populates `setInput(text || '')` and focuses the composer; no in-place mutation, no API call. The original user turn stays in the history; the re-edited text is sent as a NEW turn when the user submits.
implementation_intent: Z3 (the prior decision in 2026-02) interpreted edit-prompt as **populate-composer** semantics (Claude-style), NOT as in-place mutation of the prior turn. The user must RE-DECIDE intent if a different semantics is desired.

decision_options_for_user.summary: Keep the current populate-composer Z3 semantics. No build needed; the affordance is already shipping.
decision_options_for_user.consequence: Stage C closes as VERIFIED on all four items.

decision_options_for_user.summary: Replace populate-composer with in-place revision: user can edit a submitted prompt and re-send THE SAME turn (mutates the existing message; new assistant reply replaces the prior). History preserves both versions via the audit log.
decision_options_for_user.consequence: Build required: new PATCH /chats/{cid}/messages/{mid} endpoint (or extend existing) + FE in-place editor + Shield re-screen of the edited text + new audit row type. Larger than Stage C scope.

decision_options_for_user.summary: Branching pattern (ChatGPT-style): editing creates a sibling branch; user can navigate between branches. Major UX + data-model shift.
decision_options_for_user.consequence: Build required: branch-aware chat data model + FE branch navigator + Shield audit chain per branch. Substantially larger than Stage C scope.

agent_recommendation: No-action close UNLESS the user wants OPTION_B or OPTION_C. The Z3 semantics are coherent with the rest of the surface (history immutability, audit chain, Shield re-screen on every new turn — all preserved). If the user finds the populate-composer semantics insufficient, the choice is OPTION_B (in-place) or OPTION_C (branching) — both are build-scoped phases beyond Stage C.
